# lua-resty-yar

> High-performance Yar RPC framework for OpenResty, built on lua-yar — provides cosocket injection, content_by_lua handlers, process-level instance management, plugin registry, structured config schema, lifecycle hooks, and observability (metrics / trace / access-log) for HTTP / TCP stream Yar RPC services. Interoperable with PHP Yar / yar-c.

lua-resty-yar bridges the pure Lua [lua-yar](https://github.com/fangfengxiang/lua-yar) protocol library into OpenResty's non-blocking I/O runtime. It is an OPM package (OpenResty Package Manager), not a standalone protocol implementation — all protocol logic (framing, header parsing, encoding/decoding, packager registry, hooks, error classification) is delegated to lua-yar. Beyond protocol bridging, lua-resty-yar provides framework-level capabilities: plugin registry with priority-based ordering, structured config schema with nested domains and flat backward compat, lifecycle hook adaptation (on_error / on_timeout derived from on_response), and observability instrumentation (Prometheus metrics, W3C trace context propagation, structured JSON access logging).

## Quick Start

```nginx
http {
    lua_package_path "/path/to/lua-yar/src/?.lua;/path/to/lua-yar/src/?/init.lua;;";

    init_by_lua_block {
        require("resty.yar").setup {
            service = { add = function(a, b) return a + b end },
        }
    }

    server {
        listen 8888;
        location /api {
            content_by_lua_block { require("resty.yar.server").serve() }
        }
    }
}
```

Install: `opm get fangfengxiang/lua-resty-yar` (requires lua-yar: `luarocks install lua-yar`)

## Modules

- `resty.yar` — Main entry: `setup()`, `get_server()`, `new_client()`, `get_client()`, `init_worker()`
- `resty.yar.server` — Unified server entry: `serve()` (auto-detects HTTP/stream)
- `resty.yar.server.http` — HTTP handler: `serve()` (content_by_lua entry)
- `resty.yar.server.tcp` — TCP stream handler: `serve()` (stream content_by_lua entry)
- `resty.yar.client` — Client wrapper: `new()`, `get()`
- `resty.yar.config` — Structured config schema: nested domains, flat backward compat, type validation
- `resty.yar.registry` — Plugin registry: `register()`, `get_hooks()`, priority + named compose
- `resty.yar.hooks` — Lifecycle hook adapter: `adapt()`, `compose()`, on_error/on_timeout derivation
- `resty.yar.observability` — Metrics: worker-local buffer, histogram, shdict export
